title: Ek Raat Mein Gayab Ho Gaya Poora Gaon 😱 Kuldhara Ka Shraap #shorts
description:
Jaisalmer ka Kuldhara gaon — 200 saal se veeraan! 😱
Kehte hain, Paliwal Brahmin ek hi raat mein apna ghar chhodkar chale gaye… aur jaate jaate shraap de gaye.

Diwan Salim Singh ka zulm? Ya paani ki kami? 🤔
Aapko kya lagta hai — SHRAAP ya PAANI? 👇 Comment mein batao!

📜 Itihaas: Kuldhara ko lagbhag 13vi sadi mein Paliwal Brahmanon ne basaya tha. 1825 ke aas-paas ye gaon aur aas-paas ke gaon khaali ho gaye.
👻 Ek raat mein gayab hone aur shraap ki baatein lok-kathayein (folklore) hain. Itihaaskar paani ki kami aur bhaari tax ko wajah maante hain.
